verdict.rationale: Factory documents a public API reference for creating and driving Droid sessions, covering lifecycle, settings and messages. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.factory.ai/openapi.json, and a first-party SDK runs the same agent harness from code. Missing for 10: endpoint coverage beyond sessions, authentication and rate-limit details, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Create and drive Droid sessions: manage their lifecycle, settings, and messages.
